description: This file defines the 'GenericEngine' interface for service execution modes (synchronous and asynchronous) within the Apache OFBiz framework, including method signatures for running services and handling callbacks.

classes.name: GenericEngine
classes.description: Interface for executing services synchronously and asynchronously, and managing callbacks within the OFBiz service engine.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously and returns the result as a Map.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously, ignoring the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Executes a service asynchronously, passing a requester to receive the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Executes a service asynchronously, ignoring the result.

methods.name: sendCallbacks
methods.description: Sends callbacks for a service execution, with different overloads for result, errors, and mode.
